papers.title: $Φ$asmaNet: A Staged Spectral Token-Refinement Architecture for Fast Gravitational-Wave Signal-to-Noise Ratio Prediction
papers.summary: Compact neural architecture with staged spectral token refinement predicts gravitational-wave signal-to-noise ratios for precessing binary black hole signals, reaching high accuracy and about 100-fold speedup.
papers.tldr: asmaNet is presented, a compact neural architecture for structured tabular regression, with staged spectral refinement as an explicit architectural prior, for gravitational-wave population studies and results on public tabular datasets indicate competitiveness beyond gravitational-wave applications.

papers.title: Beyond Point Photo-$z$ Estimates: Normalizing Flows for Tomographic $N(z)$ Reconstruction with DESI DR1
papers.summary: Conditional normalizing flows trained on DESI DR1 and Legacy Surveys photometry reconstruct tomographic redshift distributions, outperforming random-forest baselines at high redshift.

papers.title: Contrastive Astromer: Two-Stage Contrastive Representation Learning for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
papers.summary: Two-stage contrastive adaptation of ASTROMER light-curve representations improves frozen-encoder classification, reaching macro-F1 0.794 with 500 labeled examples per class.
papers.tldr: Results show that contrastive adaptation makes pretrained light-curve representations more effective for classification and more informative about the structure of variability classes.

papers.title: Boosted Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Lane-Emden Type Equations
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural networks boosted by tree ensembles and support vector regression solve Lane-Emden equations for stellar-structure models, reducing error versus standard PINN baselines.
papers.tldr: This study presents a novel hybrid framework that integrates Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) with boosting methods to enhance the accuracy and robustness of solutions for Lane-Emden type differential equations.

papers.title: Learned Surrogates of Three-Dimensional Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
papers.summary: Convolutional UNet, shifted-window transformer and Fourier neural operator surrogates emulate three-dimensional resistive MHD turbulence, matching simulation statistics and outperforming published benchmarks.

papers.title: The Agentic Observer Hackathon: Autonomous Decision-making in Simulated Astronomical Surveys
papers.summary: Community hackathon evaluates autonomous systems, including language models, for allocating observing time in a synthetic multi-object survey with faults and competing priorities.
papers.tldr: This work evaluates systems submitted by 102 teams on campaigns reserved for evaluation and analyse target completion in a reference campaign, finding the leading systems combine numerical exposure planning with language models for interpreting operational information and supporting longer-term decisions.

papers.title: SHAPE: Solar Heliospherical Analysis and Prediction of Eruptions A machine learning approach to solar flare forecasting
papers.summary: Two-phase deep-learning pipeline forecasts monthly and next-day solar flare classes from GOES X-ray data, achieving skill but sometimes matching persistence.
papers.tldr: Solar Heliospherical Analysis and Prediction of Eruptions (SHAPE), a two-phase deep-learning pipeline that bypasses sunspot proxies in favour of direct soft X-ray observations from the GOES X-ray Sensor, shows that competitive flare forecasting is achievable with compact architectures that retain in minutes on standard hardware, without sunspot proxy inputs.

papers.title: A Physics Informed Neural Network Approach to Decipher Environmental Confinement of Molecular Clouds in the Third Galactic Quadrant
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural network incorporating external pressure reclassifies 2,091 Milky Way molecular clouds as pressure-confined and links stability to star formation.

papers.title: A multiprobe $\Lambda$CDM consistency analysis with gravitational-wave standard sirens
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to A&A Letters
papers.summary: Normalizing-flow combination of gravitational-wave standard sirens with DES, BAO, supernovae, and CMB probes finds S8=0.793 and H0=69.4, leaving S8 and H0 tensions essentially unchanged.

papers.title: Forecasting the Ambient Solar Wind With a Physics-Informed Learned Inner Boundary: Part I-Differentiable Inverse Reconstruction From Solar Images
papers.summary: Differentiable physics-informed model maps SDO images and magnetograms to the 21.5 solar-radii wind boundary, improving >600 km/s forecasting over recurrence and linear baselines.

papers.title: Effects of Competing Reactions on $^{59}\mathrm{Cu}$ and $^{63}\mathrm{Ga}$ on Abundance Distributions in Type I X-Ray Bursts
papers.summary: XGBoost classification and SHAP attribution of Monte Carlo X-ray burst models identify competing (p,α) and (p,γ) reactions on 59Cu and 63Ga as the main source of secondary abundance peaks.

papers.title: Recovering Missing Degrees of Freedom in Simulation-Trained Field-Level Generative Models
papers.summary: Physics-informed latent corrections to a simulation-trained continuous normalizing flow recover variability lost to variance shrinkage in weak-lensing field-level inference, improving robustness to out-of-distribution shifts.

excluded.title: Two Fast Radio Burst Candidates Detected in the RATAN-600 Blind Survey
